subject: HyperPath POC — request for dedicated pool & 72h soft-reserve
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-08T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: HyperPath POC — request for dedicated pool & 72h soft-reserve

Hi Ben / Grace,

Quick heads-up: HyperPath (contact Sara Lin) just moved the PoC into late-stage procurement. Attached is the requirements doc they shared — short summary below. They want a dedicated pool to guarantee latency and isolation during the 8-week PoC.

Ask: Can we confirm internal availability for a dedicated pool of 6x A100-80GB-equivalent nodes (est. sustained serving load) and put a 72-hour soft-reserve on that capacity while legal/pricing finalizes? Start date requested: 2026-11-01.

Requirements summary (from customer doc):
- Dedicated capacity: 6 concurrent A100-80GB-equivalent workers (multi-GPU nodes)
- Avg p95 latency target: <150ms for chat generation (context ~2k tokens)
- Expected traffic pattern: 300rps spikes during demo windows, sustained 60-80rps otherwise
- Data isolation required (no multi-tenant sharing for the PoC period)
- PoC length: ~8 weeks with potential for Dedicated contract post-PoC

I'm copying the inventory folks on this thread to check immediate availability and to request the soft-reserve. If there's a shortfall, please advise on mitigation options (mix of newer/older hardware, staged start, or transient burst capacity).

Attachments: HyperPath_POC_requirements.pdf (customer doc).

Thanks — Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops-reservations@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-08T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HyperPath POC — request for dedicated pool & 72h soft-reserve

Neha — thanks for the context and the doc. I pulled the latest inventory snapshot (attached) and ran a quick availability check. Short summary:

- Physical availability: We currently have 9 nodes with A100-80GB-equivalent capacity in US-west that are not committed past 2026-11-05. However, 3 of those are earmarked for scheduled maintenance windows the week of 2026-10-25 — we can flip maintenance windows but that adds ops risk.
- If we require strict single-tenant isolation on 6 nodes, we have capacity but only if we take a 72h soft-reserve while legal & procurement complete. Without a reserve, there's a material risk (estimated 35%) another committed deal could absorb the same pool in the next 10 days.
- Alternative mitigation: split the PoC into 4 dedicated nodes US-west + 2 in US-east (same region-latency envelope for their use case) or provide 4 dedicated nodes + 2 pre-warmed shared nodes with strict KV/prefix cache partitioning (reduced isolation but lower risk).

Action I'm taking: opening OPS ticket OPS-9872 to request a 72h soft-reserve on 6 A100-80GB-equivalent workers in US-west and to flag the 2026-10-25 maintenance window as negotiable. Ops, please confirm reservation window and any operational caveats.

If we can confirm the 72h lock, I'll communicate to HyperPath that capacity is tentatively held pending contract/PO.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Principal Capacity Planner, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: gpu_inventory_snapshot_20261008.csv
From: Sara Lin <sara@hyperpath.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-08T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HyperPath POC — request for dedicated pool & 72h soft-reserve

Hi Neha — thanks for the update and for looping Ben/ops. Confirming HyperPath's intent: we want the PoC to be as close to production as possible and require single-tenant nodes for data isolation. 6 nodes starting 2026-11-01 is ideal.

Questions for Redwood:
1) Can you place a short hold while we complete our internal procurement (we expect to finish by COB 2026-10-11)?
2) If you need to split across regions, would that materially impact latency for our demo users (primarily west coast)?
3) Any docs on the proposed isolation approach for the pre-warmed shared nodes (if you propose that fallback)?

We're happy to sign a refundable deposit or MOU to secure a reservation if that's helpful. Let us know what you need from our side.

Thanks — Sara

Sara Lin
Head of Integrations, HyperPath AI
sara@hyperpath.ai
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, ops-reservations@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@redwood.ai, finance@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-08T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HyperPath POC — request for dedicated pool & 72h soft-reserve

Ben / Ops team / Grace —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Ben, please proceed with OPS-9872 and request the 72-hour soft-reserve for 6 A100-80GB-equivalent nodes in US-west with start date 2026-11-01. Include the maintenance window note and ask ops to confirm whether the reserve requires a refundable deposit or MOU.

Grace — can you prep a short MOU template we can share with HyperPath (1 page) that covers: length of hold (72h), refundable deposit amount (if ops requires), and the start date/PoC length? Legal & Finance are on copy to expedite.

Sara — we'll aim to confirm the hold within 24 hours of the OPS ticket response. Regarding region split: Ben flagged a potential split (4 west / 2 east) as a mitigation; I'll have engineering quantify p95 impact if we need to propose that fallback. For the isolation docs, I'll share our isolation/partitioning note if we need to propose pre-warmed shared nodes as a contingency.

Next steps:
- OPS: confirm reservation window & caveats (OPS-9872) — target response within 6 business hours
- Grace: MOU draft by EOD 2026-10-08
- Ben/Infra: confirm whether maintenance windows can be adjusted without impacting the proposed start date
- I'll reply to HyperPath with the provisional reservation and attach the MOU when ready

Thanks — Neha
